ids.description: Remember something the user says about themselves, forget something, or say what is remembered.
Add a reminder to the Reminders app, possibly at a time.
Add an event or meeting to the Calendar app at a given time.
Find when the user is free on a day, from their calendar.
Answer what is on the user's calendar, or whether they are free, for a day or time.
Switch dark or light mode, or change, mute or unmute the volume.
Run one of the user's own shortcuts from the Shortcuts app.
Write a note in the Notes app from what the user said, or from what they have selected or open.
Tidy a folder by moving its files into subfolders, grouped by type, project or date.
Find a file the user is describing from memory and show them where it is.
Rename a group of files so they follow one consistent naming pattern.
Create folders, open things in a chosen application, or run one simple safe command.
